selection: One epoch per mode minimizing max across roles of mean SB-hRMSE/reference; tie mean then earliest epoch. Reference is existing train-only fixed prior; used only for normalization.
scope: Repeated-use inner development only; no outer validation/test forecasts for selection. No refit at this stage.
change: Training augmentation only; unchanged native Sequential and inference. Joint family end-to-end compares masking/noise; fixed family freezes same parent prior and compares clean vs perturbed-prior adapter training.
support_mask: Drop earlier available time blocks independently p=.5, always retain last block and same cutoff. Same-time replicates masked together. No query changes.
support_noise: Per-time-block log noise, Gaussian clipped at 2 SD; estimated from training support replicates only, clipped .01-.10. If no positive estimate, predeclared .05 robustness stress.
prior_jitter: Fixed family only. 50% of supported profiles: CL/Vc log shift with train-drug prior-output SD x .25 clipped [.05,.2], Gaussian clipped 2 SD; no k=0 shift. No changes to labels/doses. All evaluation clean.
frozen_parent: Same train-only prior, reused across seeds; fresh observer initialized independently per seed. No prior retraining.
secondary_evaluation: k=0,1,4 at k=2 selected checkpoints, no reselection.
contrastive_gate: Proceed only if an augmentation has mean SB-hRMSE no worse than its matched family native in BOTH inner tracks and strictly better in at least one; otherwise defer. Do not select from outer test.
noise_scope: Not estimating biological variability or generating new independent drugs.
